description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the 'WishList' controller within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages user wishlist functionalities including viewing, listing, adding, and removing products from the wishlist, with methods to handle these actions and generate appropriate JSON or view responses.

classes.name: WishList
classes.description: Controller class handling wishlist operations for logged-in customers within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the wishlist page, verifying login and customer token validity, setting page titles and breadcrumbs, and rendering the wishlist view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the wishlist view as HTML content wrapped in a JSON response.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns a JSON string containing the wishlist items for the current user.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product to the wishlist, creating a JSON response indicating success or failure, with redirection for non-logged-in users.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a product from the wishlist, returning a JSON response with success or error messages.
